external_source.role: external RNA-seq transportability test of frozen R7A2 pathway axis

forbidden: remove a BeatAML wave because of unfavorable performance
change mapping thresholds after seeing results
claim prognosis, treatment benefit, or validated AML subtype from R7B

preprocessing.gene_ranking: within-sample percentile ranks computed across the mapped AML-GraphRx 9554-gene universe; no cohort centering or external parameter fitting
preprocessing.sample_selection: official manuscript-style clinical flags where available: used_manuscript_analyses == yes AND manuscript_rnaseq == yes

primary_external_biology_test.interpretation: negative correlation supports preservation of the antagonistic pathway structure; it is not a subtype-classification endpoint
primary_external_biology_test.metric: Spearman correlation between aggregate S03-high and S06-high component means
